identity.title: C-SDLC v2 bind is blocked by unrelated stale worktree records

values.goal: Prove bind ignores unrelated legacy claim-bearing projections while preserving strict collision detection.
values.required_outcome: A real csdlc-bind canary succeeds with an unrelated stale claim-bearing record, but relevant malformed records and true collisions still fail closed.
authority_boundary: Git branch and canonical worktree remain ownership authority
Only records relevant by issue, branch, or canonical path receive full verification
operator_constraints: Prefer regression-only completion if current main already behaves correctly
